measurement_notes: Job estimates remain null until a completed gate records a representative output size; unknown is not a reservation. The Icarus estimate is a measured existing output-tree snapshot and is not a filesystem high-water measurement.
The Icarus output-tree limit is twice that measured snapshot so accumulated small files also trigger review.
The developer profile warns below 50 GiB and blocks below a 40 GiB reserve; these are configurable workstation safeguards, not architecture limits.
The hosted profile retains the existing 2 GiB free-space floor and is independent of developer-workstation thresholds.
